authority.accepted_proposal: Establish and check a controlled handover after a mission and its branches finish; resume only untouched assignments; carry cumulative resource usage; replace repeated directory scans with efficient storage accounting; record the monitoring-only implementation amendment.

handover.boundary: Root cell closeout after source, branches and cleanup; journal proves every admitted source is finished and has a closeout; no non-tracker worker remains.
handover.mechanism: Reversible OS pause on closeout; if next source already admitted, continue unchanged and await next boundary. Kill paused predecessor only after validated boundary and frozen bindings. No active trial is killed or restarted.

resource_accounting.wall: Original process creation to completion, including handover; no clock reset.
resource_accounting.cpu: Predecessor full process plus child CPU carried forward, plus successor process and child CPU including verification.
resource_accounting.gpu_owner: Conservatively charge entire original-to-final wall duration, including pause, against unchanged 72-hour cap.
resource_accounting.storage: Cache completed source-directory byte totals; scan writable current source and root files every resource check. Reconcile all closed totals at each assignment boundary and finalization. Unexpected closed-tree size change stops. Preserve existing 0.5-second check cadence, forced admissions, cache-growth sampling and filesystem reserves.
resource_accounting.cache_growth: Carry maximum historical cache growth and add positive growth since handover baseline; conservative, no allowance reset.
resource_accounting.peak_rss_vram_retained: Carry historical maxima. Retain previous resource measurements and append to the original journal.

compute_caps.comparative_selections_or_rankings: Explicit Phase 2 V4.1 approval recorded with exact configuration SHA-256

checks: real OS pause of synthetic owner before next assignment

read_only_size_scan_benchmark.caveat: Current source has little on-disk output; current-source scan grows during branching. Not an end-to-end simulation speedup estimate.

output_integrity.receipt_caveat: Predecessor in-memory converter receipt is not transferable. Existing output files were checked immediately by the unchanged bound converter; final receipt enumerates successor writes.

terminal_scope: Finish the same fixed audit, branch panel and decision memo, then stop. No further recommendation execution.
